page.title.channel_orders.explanation: Browser tab title of the Online orders page.

page.title.move_till.explanation: Browser tab title of the page where a manager approves or declines moving this till into another shop.

page.title.notices.explanation: Browser tab title of the Notices inbox page.

settings.backup.delete.explanation: Button on a row of the backups list that deletes that backup file.

settings.backup.delete_confirm.explanation: Question asked before a backup file is deleted from the backups list.

settings.backup.delete_failed.explanation: Error when deleting a backup file failed.

settings.backup.delete_invalid.explanation: Error when the name sent to delete is not a backup file.

settings.backup.delete_missing.explanation: Error when the backup to delete is already gone.

settings.backup.delete_newest.explanation: Error when someone tries to delete the newest backup, which is always kept.

settings.backup.deleted.explanation: Confirmation shown after a backup file was deleted.

settings.backup.newest_kept.explanation: Label on the newest backup row, which has no Delete button because it is always kept.

settings.backup.picker_cancelled.explanation: Backups list message when the operator closed the Android file picker without choosing a place.

settings.backup.picker_failed.explanation: Backups list message when writing the backup to the place chosen in the Android file picker failed.

settings.backup.picker_no_space.explanation: Backups list message when the place chosen in the Android file picker is full.

settings.backup.picker_saved.explanation: Backups list message after the Android file picker saved the backup copy.

settings.backup.restore_refused.explanation: Notice in Settings → Backups after the till refused, at restart, a staged restore whose file was not a usable till database. Shown until the next restore is staged.

settings.backup.retention_days.explanation: Label of the number field: how many days of backups the till keeps.

settings.backup.retention_failed.explanation: Error when the backup days setting could not be saved.

settings.backup.retention_hint.explanation: Help under the backup days field: older backups are deleted automatically when the next one is made; the newest is always kept.

settings.backup.retention_invalid.explanation:
Error for a backup days value that is not a whole number in range.

Placeholders:
- %d: the largest allowed number of days

settings.backup.retention_save.explanation: Button that saves the backup days setting.

settings.backup.retention_saved.explanation: Confirmation shown after the backup days setting was saved.

settings.backup.safety_failed.explanation: Error in Settings → Backups when the till could not snapshot the current data before a restore, so the restore was not staged.

settings.backup.save_failed_permission.explanation: Backups list message when the till may not write to the destination folder.

settings.backup.save_failed_space.explanation: Backups list message when the copy could not be saved because the destination is full.

settings.backup.save_failed_unreachable.explanation: Backups list message when the destination folder (for example a USB drive) cannot be reached.

settings.backup.save_failed_use_picker.explanation: Backups list message on Android when a direct save is refused because the app saves through its file picker.

settings.backup.upload.action.explanation: Button that uploads the chosen backup file so the till can check it. Nothing is restored yet.

settings.backup.upload.checking.explanation: Shown while the backup file uploads and is checked (can take a while for a large file).

settings.backup.upload.error.failed.explanation: Generic error when checking an uploaded backup failed for a reason on the till's side.

settings.backup.upload.error.newer.explanation: Error when the uploaded backup's database schema is newer than this till's build.

settings.backup.upload.error.no_file.explanation: Error when the form was sent without a file.

settings.backup.upload.error.no_space.explanation: Error when the disk is already below the low-disk floor, so no upload is accepted.

settings.backup.upload.error.not_backup.explanation: Error when the uploaded file is not a till database or fails the integrity check. Product name and file pattern stay unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.error.other_shop.explanation: Error when the uploaded backup names a different my. shop than the one this till is paired with.

settings.backup.upload.error.too_large.explanation:
Error when the uploaded file is over the size cap (a fixed maximum, or less when the disk is fuller).

Placeholders:
- %s: the largest file size allowed, for example 1.5 GB

settings.backup.upload.error.too_old.explanation: Error when the uploaded backup comes from a version before the database schema reset, which this build cannot open.

settings.backup.upload.help.explanation: Help line under 'Restore from a file'. The file name pattern unitill-pos-….db stays unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.label.explanation: Label of the file picker for the backup file to restore.

settings.backup.upload.live_sales.explanation: Extra warning above the Restore button when this till has already rung up sales.

settings.backup.upload.newest_sale.explanation:
Line in the checked-backup summary: the date and time of the newest sale in the backup, the cut-off of what a restore brings back.

Placeholders:
- %s: the date and time of the newest sale

settings.backup.upload.no_sales.explanation: Line in the checked-backup summary when the backup holds no sales.

settings.backup.upload.ready.explanation: Shown after an uploaded backup passed every check; the file name follows on the same line. Product name stays unchanged.

settings.backup.upload.replaces.explanation: Warning above the Restore button for an uploaded backup.

settings.backup.upload.restore.explanation: Button that restores the uploaded, checked backup (asks for the manager PIN next).

settings.backup.upload.sales.explanation:
Line in the checked-backup summary: how many sales the backup holds.

Placeholders:
- %d: the number of sales

settings.backup.upload.shop.explanation:
Line in the checked-backup summary naming the shop the backup belongs to.

Placeholders:
- %s: the shop name stored in the backup

settings.backup.upload.title.explanation: Heading of the part of Settings → Backups where a manager uploads a backup file (for example from a USB stick) to restore it.

settings.currency_display.auto.explanation: Option in the currency display choice: the product picks symbol or code per currency.

settings.currency_display.code.explanation: Option in the currency display choice: always write the three-letter currency code (for example GBP).

settings.currency_display.help.explanation: Help line under the currency display choice; says what the three options do and that receipts fall back to the code when the printer cannot print the symbol.

settings.currency_display.symbol.explanation: Option in the currency display choice: always write the currency symbol (for example the pound sign).

settings.currency_display.title.explanation: Heading of the Settings card choice that sets how amounts write the shop currency (symbol, code or automatic).

settings.display.awake.explanation: Label of the Android-only Settings > Display dropdown that sets how long the till keeps the tablet screen on without a touch.

settings.display.awake_help.explanation: Help line under the Android-only keep-screen-on dropdown.

settings.display.awake_hours.explanation:
Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen may sleep after this many idle hours.

Placeholders:
- %d: number of hours

settings.display.awake_minutes.explanation:
Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen may sleep after this many idle minutes.

Placeholders:
- %d: number of minutes

settings.display.awake_never.explanation: Option in the keep-screen-on dropdown: the screen never sleeps while the till app is open.

settings.enrol.pair_help.explanation: Only used by till line 0.34; kept while that line is supported (ADR-0160 §5).

settings.enrol.pair_help_2.explanation: Explanation under the Pair with a shop heading in Settings → Till registration. The two quoted names are the exact button labels on my.universaltill.com (Pair a till / Pair again); translators should use the my. translations of those labels.

settings.enrol.pair_identity_pinned.explanation: Error shown under Settings → Pair with a shop when the till's cloud identity is fixed by UT_MARKETPLACE_* environment variables, so the pairing code was not used and a new code will not help.

settings.enrol.pair_replace_body.explanation:
Body of that confirmation: what replacing the connection means and the risk of a wrong code; no compliance claims. 1st placeholder: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set; 2nd: the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted. Keep both placeholders; the till wraps each in bidi isolates.

Placeholders:
- %s: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set
- %s: the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted (keep as is)

settings.enrol.pair_replace_confirm.explanation: Primary (red) button of that confirmation; pairs this till with the code, replacing its current cloud connection (Cancel is common.cancel).

settings.enrol.pair_replace_title.explanation: Heading of the confirmation shown after pressing Pair under Settings → Pair with a shop on a till that is already connected to a shop's cloud account.

settings.enrol.terms.accept_btn.explanation: Button under Settings → Till registration (already registered till, cloud terms not yet accepted) that records the ticked acceptance of the cloud service terms and sends it to the cloud.

settings.enrol.terms.accept_required.explanation: Error shown when the operator presses Accept terms on an already registered till without ticking the cloud service terms checkbox; nothing was recorded or sent.

settings.enrol.terms.accepted.explanation:
Muted line in Settings and the setup wizard once the operator has accepted the current cloud service terms. 1st placeholder: the terms version (e.g. v0.1-draft, keep as is); 2nd: the date accepted (YYYY-MM-DD).

Placeholders:
- %s: the terms version identifier, e.g. v0.1-draft
- %s: the date the terms were accepted (YYYY-MM-DD)

settings.enrol.terms.label.explanation:
Label of the checkbox the operator ticks to accept the Universal Till cloud service terms before the till registers with the cloud (consent wording: translate faithfully, do not soften or add claims).

Placeholders:
- %s: the terms version identifier, e.g. v0.1-draft

settings.enrol.terms.link.explanation: Link next to the terms checkbox that opens the cloud service terms page in a new tab.

settings.enrol.terms.send_btn.explanation: Button under Settings → Till registration, shown when the cloud service terms are accepted on this till but the acceptance has not reached the cloud yet; it sends it again.

settings.enrol.terms.send_failed.explanation: Error shown after Accept terms / Send to the cloud when the cloud could not be reached. The acceptance is kept on this till and the operator can try again; nothing else is affected.

settings.enrol.terms.unsent.explanation: Muted note under Settings → Till registration: the cloud service terms were accepted on this till, but the acceptance has not yet been delivered to the cloud (for example the till was offline).

settings.enrol.terms_required.explanation: Error shown when the operator tries to register the till (or turn on automatic registration) without ticking the cloud service terms checkbox; nothing was sent.

settings.language.download_group.explanation: Label of the group in Settings → Language's language list holding languages not installed yet, which download from the plugin catalog when picked.

settings.language.downloads_on_select.explanation: Note under Settings → Language: a language from the download group installs in the background when applied, and the till switches to it once it has arrived.

settings.language.install_unavailable.explanation:
Status chip on Settings → Language when a picked language left the download queue without arriving (not in the catalog, or removed under Settings → Data). The till's language is unchanged.

Placeholders:
- %s: the language's own name, e.g. Deutsch

settings.language.installing.explanation:
Status chip on Settings → Language while a picked language downloads in the background.

Placeholders:
- %s: the language's own name, e.g. Deutsch

settings.language.switching.explanation:
Status chip on Settings → Language when the picked language has finished downloading and the till is switching to it.

Placeholders:
- %s: the language's own name, e.g. Deutsch

settings.move.approve.explanation: Primary button: approve moving this till into the other shop (asks for a PIN next).

settings.move.confirm_body.explanation:
Body of that confirmation. Keep both placeholders; the till wraps each in bidi isolates.

Placeholders:
- %s: the shop's name, or its store ID when no shop name is set
- %s: the pairing code the operator typed, shown so a typo can be spotted (keep as is)

settings.move.confirm_btn.explanation: Primary button of that confirmation: send the code and ask for the move.

settings.move.confirm_title.explanation: Heading of the confirmation after pressing Pair on a till that belongs to a shop, where pairing asks to move it.

settings.move.decline.explanation: Secondary button: decline the move (asks for a PIN next). Nothing moves.

settings.move.declined.explanation: After a declined move (or one already declined).

settings.move.done.explanation:
Success after an approved move.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the shop the till moved into

settings.move.expires.explanation: Label before the date and time after which the move request expires and nothing moves.

settings.move.from.explanation: Label before the name of the shop this till belongs to now, on the move approval page.

settings.move.gone.explanation: Shown on the move page when the move is unknown or already ended.

settings.move.into.explanation: Label before the name of the shop the till would move into, on the move approval page.

settings.move.locked.explanation: After 3 wrong PINs on one move: it is declined automatically.

settings.move.name_mismatch.explanation: Error when the typed target shop name does not match; nothing was sent and no PIN was asked.

settings.move.notice_cancelled.explanation:
Banner after the target owner cancelled a pending move.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_expired.explanation:
Banner after a pending move expired.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_locked.explanation:
Banner after a move was declined automatically for wrong PINs.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the shop the move was into

settings.move.notice_pending.explanation:
Banner for managers/admins when a move waits for this till's approval.

Placeholders:
- %s: the name of the shop asking to take the till
- %s: the date and time the request expires

settings.move.notice_review.explanation: Link in the move banner (and after pairing) that opens the approval page.

settings.move.offline.explanation: Shown when the cloud is out of reach: the decision cannot be sent; nothing is queued.

settings.move.pending_msg.explanation: After Pair: the cloud recorded the move; it waits for approval on this till.

settings.move.refused.explanation: Generic refusal of a move request (wrong code, server error...).

settings.move.refused_declined_recently.explanation: Move refused: a recent decline blocks this requester for a day.

settings.move.refused_fiscal_device.explanation: Move refused: the till's shop has a fiscal device (e.g. TSE). No compliance claims.

settings.move.refused_needs_owner.explanation: Move refused: the code was made by a member, not the owner.

settings.move.refused_other_owner.explanation: Move refused: the till's shop has a different owner.

settings.move.refused_paid_licence.explanation: Move refused: the till's shop has a paid/granted plan.

settings.move.refused_pending.explanation: Move refused: another move is already pending for this till.

settings.move.refused_shop_has_tills.explanation: Move refused: the till's current shop has other tills.

settings.move.refused_source_unavailable.explanation: Move refused: the till's current shop is unavailable (deleted or merging).

settings.move.refused_target_unavailable.explanation: Move refused: the target shop already has a main till, is merging, or is unavailable.

settings.move.result_cancelled.explanation: The target shop's owner cancelled the move on my.

settings.move.result_done.explanation: The cloud says the move already happened.

settings.move.result_error.explanation: Any other failure sending the decision.

settings.move.result_expired.explanation: The cloud says the move expired.

settings.move.result_failed.explanation: The cloud refused the move after approval (state changed) or moves are switched off.

settings.move.result_invalid.explanation: Signature or credential refused by the cloud.

settings.move.result_key.explanation: Approval key conflict, missing or unusable on the till.

settings.move.result_quarantined.explanation:
The till's approval key was reported recently and is in its waiting period.

Placeholders:
- %s: the date and time from which the till can approve

settings.move.source_lost.explanation: Pair refused on the till: its old shop credential is dead and it has history; nothing changed.

settings.move.summary_approve.explanation: What the PIN dialog says is being approved (approve a move).

settings.move.summary_decline.explanation: What the PIN dialog says is being approved (decline a move).

settings.move.title.explanation: Heading of the page where a manager or admin approves or declines moving this till (with its history) into another shop's cloud account.

settings.move.type_name.explanation: Label of the text field where the approver types the target shop's name (shown right after the label) before Approve works.

settings.move.warning.explanation: Plain warning on the move approval page: what approving does (all history goes to the other account) and an anti-scam line. No compliance claims.

settings.move.who.explanation: Line under the warning: who decides (manager/admin PIN) and that selling continues meanwhile.

settings.notices.enable.explanation: Checkbox label that switches Notices on for this till.

settings.notices.help.explanation: Help text of the Notices settings card: what it shows, that a notice never blocks a sale, off by default, and that turning it off removes held notices.

settings.notices.save.explanation: Save button of the Notices settings card.

settings.notices.title.explanation: Heading of the Settings card that switches Notices on or off for this till.

settings.printer.voucher_slip.explanation: Checkbox label in Settings > Receipt printer: when ticked, every gift voucher sold or topped up in a sale also prints on its own separate slip after the receipt.

settings.printer.voucher_slip_hint.explanation: Help line under the separate-gift-voucher-slip checkbox in Settings > Receipt printer: when it prints, what is on the slip (a top-up's slip adds the amount added and the new balance), and that voided vouchers and top-ups taken back get none.

settings.staff_links.help.explanation: Muted line under the 'Users and permissions' card in Settings → Staff & security, introducing the links to the Users and Permissions pages.

settings.staff_links.title.explanation: Heading of the card in Settings → Staff & security that links to the Users page (staff accounts and PINs) and the Permissions page; also its entry in the settings sidebar.

settings.tills.main_till_addr.explanation:
Line on a joined till's Settings Tills card giving the network address of the main till it follows.

Placeholders:
- %s: network address of the main till, e.g. 192.168.1.10:8080

settings.tills.role_label.explanation: Label in front of this till's role on the Settings Tills card (This till: Main till).

settings.tills.role_main.explanation: This till's role when it is the shop's main till (the one other tills join), shown after the 'This till' label.

settings.update.android.install_again.explanation: Android in-app update: shown on the update button (status-bar chip, Settings → Software update, the check-for-updates result) when Android's installer was opened but closed again or never came up on screen. Tapping the button opens the installer again with the app already downloaded.

subscription.cap.order_tracking.explanation: Name of the paid capability customer order tracking (tracking QR on the kiosk confirmation and receipt), listed on the Subscription card and in the paused-feature banner when the shop's plan no longer includes it.

subscription.plan.local_plus.explanation: Name of the Local Plus subscription plan (the cheapest paid tier), shown as the shop's plan on the Subscription card and status chip. A product name: never translate it.

translations.mode.area.explanation: Label for the part of the till the text belongs to (sale, catalog, settings...), which is also its group in the translation service.

translations.mode.current.explanation: Label for the text as the till shows it now, in the current language (the language code follows in brackets).

translations.mode.description.explanation: Label for the note that tells translators where and how the text is used.

translations.mode.empty.explanation: Error when Save is pressed with an empty override field.

translations.mode.english.explanation: Label for the English source text, shown under the current language's text when they differ.

translations.mode.hint.explanation: Short reminder in the status bar while translate mode is on: how to open a text's panel. 'Alt' is the keyboard key; keep it as on the keyboard.

translations.mode.intro.explanation: Explanation on the translation editor's Translate mode card: what the mode does and how to open a text's panel.

translations.mode.key.explanation: Label for the text's translation key (its technical identifier) in the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.max_length.explanation: Label for the most characters a translation of this text may have; the number follows it.

translations.mode.no_description.explanation: Shown in the translate-mode panel when the text has no translator note yet.

translations.mode.open_weblate.explanation: Link that opens this text in the Weblate translation service in a new tab. Weblate is a product name: never translate it.

translations.mode.other_keys.explanation: Lead-in above a list of text keys, when the pressed element shows several texts (for example a label and its tooltip).

translations.mode.override_help.explanation: Explanation under the Shop override heading. 'Reset' refers to the Reset button (translations.reset).

translations.mode.override_title.explanation: Heading of the panel section where a manager changes the wording on this till only (the same overrides as the translation editor).

translations.mode.page_areas.explanation: Heading of the list of areas (groups in the translation service) that the texts on the current page belong to.

translations.mode.page_areas_help.explanation: Explanation under 'Areas on this page': these are the translation-service groups to invite a translator to.

translations.mode.panel_title.explanation: Title of the side panel that opens when a manager Alt+clicks or long-presses a text in translate mode.

translations.mode.placeholders.explanation: Label for the list of values the till fills into the text (a name, an amount...).

translations.mode.plugin_key.explanation: Shown instead of the Weblate link when the text belongs to an installed plugin rather than the till itself.

translations.mode.qr_alt.explanation: Screen-reader description of the QR code image. Weblate is a product name: never translate it.

translations.mode.qr_hint.explanation: Hint under the QR code: scanning it opens the same link on a phone or another computer.

translations.mode.refused_kiosk.explanation: Error when someone tries to turn on translate mode on a till set up as a customer self-order kiosk.

translations.mode.reload.explanation: Button that reloads the page so a saved override shows.

translations.mode.reset_done.explanation: Confirmation after a shop override is removed from the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.saved.explanation: Confirmation after a shop override is saved from the translate-mode panel.

translations.mode.title.explanation: Name of the manager-only view mode that shows each on-screen text's translation key. Card title on the translation editor and label in the status bar.

translations.mode.turn_off.explanation: Button that turns translate mode off (status bar and translation editor).

translations.mode.turn_on.explanation: Button on the translation editor that turns translate mode on for this browser.

translations.mode.unknown_key.explanation: Message in the translate-mode panel when the pressed text's key is not known to the till.

translations.mode.weblate_title.explanation: Heading of the panel section that links the text to the shared translation service (Weblate).
